title: Stripe Credentials - How to Rotate Key
text:
## Stripe Credentials - How to Rotate Key
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000083229
This article outlines the steps to roll an API key in a Stripe account. Rolling a key involves replacing the current API key with a new one to enhance security. The process includes generating a new key in the Stripe Dashboard, updating the application with the new key, and deactivating the old key once functionality is confirmed. This practice safeguards the account from unauthorized access.

## Login to Your Account
Let's begin by logging into the Stripe account first . Look for the "Developers" view under Settings >> Developers >> Manage API Keys. Then, follow the steps below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181962991/original/vQqIPER6aq-fjclHqmqSvpFLZkjb-EWy2g.png?1783970795 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181963005/original/PcoK4-lx6PePV_jBEZmR_HPvXnnyf4Ek7g.png?1783970826 | alt: ]

## Step 1: Click on the three dots next to the key and click Rotate Key
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181963105/original/TOoowSTsxrMNLE_u3auKmOBYLvBlE2s7XA.png?1783970938 | alt: ]

## Step 2: Select the time to rotate the key
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181963155/original/u0V7ojv85p6gdaK4tYtJrVaoVTmLyyNW1Q.png?1783970982 | alt: ]
We recommend selecting " now " if you are not using the previous API key in another application.

## Step 3: Stripe will display the new API Key
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181963269/original/CfNjzgKQNJF9hKtp6ZzHANrzLShH6Mm63Q.png?1783971143 | alt: ]
VERY IMPORTANT NOTE: This API Key must be copied from Stripe into the Brilliant Directories Admin >> Payment Settings or to a safe place. Stripe, for security purposes, will only display this key once. If failed to save the key as suggested, the same steps need to be repeated.
